en_US.plugin_description: Search, inspect, copy, and update passwords stored in Nextcloud Passwords
en_US.settings_connection_tooltip: Connection settings for the Nextcloud Passwords app
en_US.base_url_tooltip: HTTPS URL of the Nextcloud server, for example https://cloud.example.com/nextcloud/
en_US.settings_security_note: Type ncp connect to authorize this device in your browser. Login credentials are never entered in Wox. The end-to-end encryption passphrase is never saved.
en_US.base_url_required: Configure the HTTPS URL of your Nextcloud server
en_US.connect_subtitle: Authorize Wox securely in your browser
en_US.connect_preview: Press **Connect Nextcloud** to open the official Nextcloud Login Flow v2. Sign in and approve access in your browser; your account password is never sent to Wox.
en_US.authorization_waiting_subtitle: Complete login and approval in your browser
en_US.authorization_waiting_preview: Wox is waiting for the one-time Login Flow response. The request expires automatically after 20 minutes.
en_US.authorization_failed: Nextcloud authorization failed; check the server URL and try again
en_US.disconnect_preview: This removes the locally saved authorization and asks Nextcloud to revoke the dedicated app password for this device.
en_US.disconnect_local_only: Local authorization removed, but Nextcloud could not be reached to revoke it
en_US.not_connected_subtitle: Run ncp connect to authorize this device
en_US.no_results_subtitle: Try a label, username, or website URL
en_US.unlock_subtitle: The Passwords API session needs additional authorization
en_US.unlock_preview: Enter the Passwords encryption passphrase and, when required, complete two-factor authentication. The passphrase is kept only in this plugin process for the active session.
en_US.label: Label
en_US.new_password_hint: Leave blank to keep the current password
en_US.https_required: Use the full HTTPS URL of your Nextcloud server
en_US.authentication_failed: Authorization is no longer valid; run ncp connect again
en_US.access_denied: The authorized account does not have access to Passwords
en_US.request_failed: The Passwords request failed; check the server and plugin logs

zh_CN.plugin_description: 搜索、查看、复制和修改 Nextcloud Passwords 中保存的密码
zh_CN.settings_connection_tooltip: 配置 Nextcloud Passwords 应用的连接信息
zh_CN.base_url_tooltip: Nextcloud 服务器的 HTTPS 地址，例如 https://cloud.example.com/nextcloud/
zh_CN.settings_security_note: 输入 ncp connect，在浏览器中授权此设备；无需在 Wox 中输入登录凭据。端到端加密口令不会保存。
zh_CN.base_url_required: 请配置 Nextcloud 服务器的 HTTPS 地址
zh_CN.connect_command: 通过 Nextcloud 授权此设备
zh_CN.disconnect_command: 撤销此设备的 Nextcloud 授权
zh_CN.connect_subtitle: 在浏览器中安全授权 Wox
zh_CN.connect_preview: 选择**连接 Nextcloud**将打开官方 Login Flow v2。请在浏览器中登录并批准访问；账户密码不会发送给 Wox。
zh_CN.authorization_waiting_title: 正在等待 Nextcloud 授权
zh_CN.authorization_waiting_subtitle: 请在浏览器中完成登录和批准
zh_CN.authorization_waiting_preview: Wox 正在等待一次性的 Login Flow 授权结果；请求将在 20 分钟后自动失效。
zh_CN.authorization_failed: Nextcloud 授权失败，请检查服务器地址后重试
zh_CN.disconnect_subtitle: 撤销此设备的专用应用密码
zh_CN.disconnect_preview: 这会移除本地保存的授权，并请求 Nextcloud 撤销为此设备生成的专用应用密码。
zh_CN.disconnect_local_only: 本地授权已移除，但无法连接 Nextcloud 撤销远端授权
zh_CN.not_connected_subtitle: 请输入 ncp connect 授权此设备
zh_CN.no_results_subtitle: 请尝试输入名称、用户名或网站地址
zh_CN.unlock_subtitle: Passwords API 会话需要额外授权
zh_CN.unlock_preview: 请输入 Passwords 加密口令，并在需要时完成双重认证。口令仅在当前会话期间保留于插件进程内存中。
zh_CN.label: 名称
zh_CN.https_required: 请使用 Nextcloud 服务器的完整 HTTPS 地址
zh_CN.authentication_failed: 授权已失效，请重新执行 ncp connect
zh_CN.access_denied: 已授权账户无权访问 Passwords
zh_CN.read_only_error: 这个共享密码条目为只读
zh_CN.request_failed: Passwords 请求失败，请检查服务器和插件日志
